content: I want a rectangular box that is 220mm wide, 300mm long and 160mm high. Let it be on the upside open and have walls with 8mm thickness and a 12mm thick bottom. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the inner dimensions of the box\\ninner_width = 220 - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides\\ninner_length = 300 - 2 * 8  # 8mm walls on both sides\\ninner_height = 160 - 12  # 12mm bottom\\n\\n# Calculate the positions for the outer and inner boxes\\nouter_x = 0\\nouter_y = 0\\nouter_z = 0\\n\\ninner_x = 8  # Offset by wall thickness\\ninner_y = 8  # Offset by wall thickness\\ninner_z = 12  # Offset by bottom thickness\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"outer_x\\\": outer_x, \\\"outer_y\\\": outer_y, \\\"outer_z\\\": outer_z,\\n    \\\"inner_x\\\": inner_x, \\\"inner_y\\\": inner_y, \\\"inner_z\\\": inner_z,\\n    \\\"inner_width\\\": inner_width, \\\"inner_length\\\": inner_length, \\\"inner_height\\\": inner_height\\n}\"}"

}"}
